# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Currently, the following versions of Nexura Product Video Media Gallery for WooCommerce are supported with security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover any security related issues, please email the project maintainers privately at security@nexurasecurity.com instead of using the public issue tracker. We take security vulnerabilities very seriously and will work with you to resolve them as quickly as possible.

Please provide a detailed report including steps to reproduce the vulnerability. You can expect an acknowledgment of your report within 48 hours.
